name: Visber
source:
A mercenary admiral hired through Pluepet Trade Firm. Doing various things to raise money, but her actions renders worthless. By money losses she sustained by get-rich-quick schemes she could purchase highest class family estate in the of the Japan planet capital center.

Really like get-rich-quick schemes and dislike crusts of bread.

"There is a need of money for the happy life. I am going to get rich, find an even more rich lover and live happily in a marriage."
